evidence_states.tested: Tested — reproducible behavior or compatibility evidence exists.
evidence_states.recommended: Recommended — current evidence meets the documented gate for a defined context.
evidence_states.stale: Stale — prior evidence exists but is outside its freshness window.
evidence_states.re_review_required: Re-review required — source or evidence changed and prior trust must not carry forward.
evidence_states.blocked: Blocked — current evidence indicates the project should not recommend installation/use.
